## Product spotlight

# **GEOTUBE**

**GEOTUBE****^{®}** dewatering containers are an effective dewatering technology fabricated from a
specially engineered geotextile which provides confinement of the fine solids inside the container,
while allowing water to permeate through the engineered geotextile. As the water drains, the solids
continue to densify and consolidate over time. Once the solids are fully consolidated or have met
minimum requirements for transport, several options are available for disposal of the dewatered
material.

Geo-Synthetics Systems LLC (GSI) is committed to safety in collaboration with quality, service and
customer satisfaction. The GSI Safety Policy is achieved through continuous awareness and commitment
to safety, starting with the orientation of any new GSI employee and ending only when they return
safely from work every day. GSI, therefore, endorses and requires a concept of safety based on the
principle that it is the basic responsibility of each department and employee of the company.

## Why Choose GSI?

When it comes to environmental containment, GSI does it all. We are a distributor, fabricator, and
installer of geosynthetic materials for a broad range of environmental containment applications,
including erosion control and contamination clean-up. For over 40 years, we have been a trusted
provider to customers in the power, solid waste, mining, and agriculture industries, gaining a
reputation as the best geosynthetic installer in the trade.

[Learn More][78]

## [Construction Materials & Fabrics][79]

GSI’s construction products focus on finding lasting environmental containment solutions for our
customers. Our slitting, seaming and re-rolling capabilities enable us to tailor products to fit
exact needs and specifications, while our large, centrally located facility allows guaranteed quick
shipments to any destination. In addition to our well-trained, Midwest-based customer service
professionals, we have product specialists located throughout the United States. Whatever your needs
or wherever your site is located, GSI is positioned to serve you.

[Learn More][80]
[[Construction Materials & Fabrics]][81]
[[Liner & Installation Services]][82]

## [Liner & Installation Services][83]

GSI is one of the largest installers of geotextile liners in the USA. Our installation services have
been utilized by a wide range of industries, including landfills, power and energy, civil
construction, EPA and Corp. of Engineers projects, pulp and paper, oil and gas, aquaculture,
agriculture and mining. GSI’s estimating, project management and construction operations are all
based in Waukesha, Wisconsin. Our installation crews operate from locations across the country,
enabling us to provide competitive local service from coast to coast.

[Learn More][84]

## [Geotextile Tubes][85]

GSI manufactures GEOSTRUX™ Geotextile Tubes for use in a wide variety of projects where dewatering
of sediments and industrial wastes is required. These applications include coal ash ponds,
industrial sludge and sediments, mining tailings, wastewater treatment plant sludge, organic and
inorganic materials, and silts and sands. We also support environmental construction efforts such as
Superfund sites where the EPA manages environmental contamination cleanup projects, as well as
dredging contractors who require efficient dewatering.

## A Leader in the Industry

GSI is one of the country’s largest independent installers of geotextile liners for landfill sites
and manages installation projects in all parts of the country. Additionally, with its GEOSTRUX™
Geotextile Tubes, GSI has supported sediment cleanup projects on waterways throughout the United
States. GSI is an authorized distributor for many of the most recognized names of geosynthetic
materials and erosion control products. GSI provides effective and responsive product distribution
to landscape, environmental engineering and general contractors from its distribution facility in
Waukesha, Wisconsin.

States. GSI is an authorized distributor for many of the most recognized names of geosynthetic
materials and erosion control products. GSI provides effective and responsive product distribution

## Product spotlight

# **GEOTUBE**

**GEOTUBE****^{®}** dewatering containers are an effective dewatering technology fabricated from a
specially engineered geotextile which provides confinement of the fine solids inside the container,
while allowing water to permeate through the engineered geotextile. As the water drains, the solids
continue to densify and consolidate over time. Once the solids are fully consolidated or have met
minimum requirements for transport, several options are available for disposal of the dewatered
material.

## Product spotlight

# **GEOTUBE**

**GEOTUBE****^{®}** dewatering containers are an effective dewatering technology fabricated from a
specially engineered geotextile which provides confinement of the fine solids inside the container,
while allowing water to permeate through the engineered geotextile. As the water drains, the solids
continue to densify and consolidate over time. Once the solids are fully consolidated or have met
minimum requirements for transport, several options are available for disposal of the dewatered
material.

## Product spotlight

# **GEOTUBE**

**GEOTUBE****^{®}** dewatering containers are an effective dewatering technology fabricated from a
specially engineered geotextile which provides confinement of the fine solids inside the container,
while allowing water to permeate through the engineered geotextile. As the water drains, the solids
continue to densify and consolidate over time. Once the solids are fully consolidated or have met
minimum requirements for transport, several options are available for disposal of the dewatered
material.

# Downley engineering and market intelligence consultancy

[ [Downley Consultants logo] ][50]

Downley Consultants is a business and engineering consultancy focused on two dynamic and growing
fields of civil engineering:
* Geosynthetics
* Underground pipe network assessment and rehabilitation

In both sectors we provide our clients with professional expert advice on market and competitive
knowledge and intelligence, and engineering design, condition assessment and solutions to problems…

[Marketing information]

Our team of highly experienced leading industry experts provides high quality and high value advice
to inform clients on markets and to solve their technical and engineering problems in our fields of
expertise. Downley Consultants celebrated its 30th anniversary in 2022 and has supported and guided
hundreds of clients around the world successfully, cost-effectively and confidentially. We are proud
of our record of consistently very high client satisfaction throughout that period, reflected in the
high level of repeat business from satisfied clients.

Downley Consultants provides its clients with high-level strategic marketing and market intelligence
so that they can make key management decisions with confidence based on robust and reliable
knowledge of the markets and competitive landscape. We do so based on our extensive engineering
expertise and knowledge in these sectors; in geosynthetics conceptual and preliminary design,
solutions development and specification to achieve sustainable and economic structures; and in
underground utility networks inspection, condition assessment and rehabilitation to extend the
service life of valuable assets that cannot easily be replaced.

Over almost 30 years we have advised and supported our clients across many key activities:
* Global, regional & local market knowledge & research
* Competitive analysis of markets and key segments
* Strategic market analysis and evaluation of options
* Positioning for optimum competitive advantage
* Review and development of winning value propositions
*  Analysis & development of sustainable and economic engineering solutions with geosynthetics
* Inspection, engineering condition assessment and rehabilitation of underground utility networks
* Professional engineering design across all applications in both geosynthetics and underground
  network rehabilitation
* Asset management plans
* Performance- and prescriptive-based technical specifications

][22]
ESI completed the installation of a ClosureTurf® landfill closure system in Georgia, providing a
sustainable, low-maintenance final cover solution for the site. By combining geosynthetics with
engineered turf technology, the system offers enhanced erosion protection while reducing the
maintenance demands often associated with traditional vegetative covers.

## Louisiana Site for New Landfill Closure Project

][23]
ESI provided geosynthetic installation services for a landfill closure project in Louisiana, helping
transform an active disposal area into a stable, environmentally protective final cover system. The
closure design was developed to minimize erosion, control stormwater runoff, and support the site's

ensuring that all projects are engineered to the highest quality standards. Our goal is to provide
value for money and quality workmanship.

With our extensive experience and skills in the geosynthetics, civil construction, and environmental
containment sectors, we have forged long-standing partnerships and strategic alliances worldwide.

This allows us to source and test quality materials that meet even the most stringent criteria.

The South African Chapter of the International Geosynthetics Society (IGS) established in 1994.


You will find on this site comprehensive information on Geosynthetics – what they are, their
functions, applications and technical information – together with current news on happenings in the
Geosynthetic sector in South Africa. We will provide information on upcoming conferences and events
locally and  worldwide plus offer reports emerging from these conferences and news from relevant
industry peers.

## ABOUT

academic at the Faculty of Engineering of the University of the Witwatersrand. The founding of GIGSA
coincided with the publication of the first edition of the Minimum Requirements Series by the then
Department of Water Affairs and Forestry. The intention of the Minimum Requirements was to regulate
waste management as a whole, but also waste disposal by landfill in South Africa, which made the use
of geomembranes mandatory. This reinforced the need for an organization like GIGSA, as geosynthetics
were largely unknown construction materials at that time.


GIGSA was, furthermore, founded as the South African Chapter of the International Society of
Geosynthetics (IGS). The IGS was established in 1984 with, in broad terms, the same objectives as
GIGSA.  The IGS became the first non-founding member of the Federation of Geo-Engineering Societies
(FedIGS) in 2011.  The founding members of the FedIGS are the International Society of Soil
Mechanics and Geotechnical Engineering (ISSMGE), the International Society of Rock Mechanics (ISRM)
and the International Association for Engineering Geology and the Environment (IAEG).  The aim of
the FedIGS is to facilitate collaboration and provide means of structured and formal communication
between the organizations.

### OUR MISSION

To promote the understanding and appropriate use of geosynthetic technology throughout South Africa

## A unique solution for all environments

Engineering smart, sustainable solutions for ground, water, and environmental challenges

[
][58]
Landfill
Landfills pose significant environmental challenges because of their potential to release hazardous
gases and generate leachate that can contaminate groundwater.
[
][59]
Slope
Slopes are exposed to various environmental and hydraulic forces that can induce erosion and
instability, necessitating effective protection and reinforcement measures.
[
][60]
Water
Water and marine environments are subjected to dynamic hydraulic and environmental forces that can
induce erosion, scour, and structural damage over time.
[
][61]
Roads & Highway
Roads and highways present significant engineering challenges due to increasing traffic demands,
subgrade variability, and climate impacts, necessitating reliable solutions to enhance performance,
durability, and service life.
[
][62]
Railways
Railway infrastructure is subjected to continuous dynamic loading and environmental influences,
which can lead to ballast degradation, track deformation, and differential settlement.
[
][63]
Ports & Airports
Ports and airports require robust ground improvement and reinforcement measures to accommodate heavy
loads, mitigate settlement, and ensure long-term structural performance.

## Skaps industries provides

#### 01.

[

### Geosynthetics

][63]

*Geosynthetics* are synthetic products used to stabilize terrain. They are generally polymeric
products used to solve civil engineering problems.

#### 02.

[

### Fiberglass Fabrics

][64]

Cheaper and more flexible than carbon fiber, it is stronger than many metals by weight,
non-magnetic, non-conductive, transparent to electromagnetic radiation.

#### 03.

### Structural Core Material

Composite core materials are customized to complete the function of engineered structures.

#### 04.

### civil applications

Skaps Geosynthetics are used as drains and filters in civil and environmental activities in addition
to replacement of conventional materials.

#### 05.

[

### environmental applications

][65]

Skaps Geosynthetics are used in a variety of situations including pipeline construction, water
filtration, prevention of soil erosion, and protection. 

#### 06.

[

### industrial applications

][66]

These applications include roads, airfields, railroads, embankments, retaining structures,
reservoirs, canals, dams, and more.

#### Serving contractors and engineers with detailed freight coordination

Southern Geo Supply brings together erosion control products, [geosynthetics][50], and construction
supplies with a focus on helping contractors and engineers secure what they need for each site.
Whether you're managing ground stabilization or coordinating material delivery across state lines,
you're working with a supplier that treats every order as a distinct project. The pre-order model
supports flexible pickup, delivery, and nationwide commercial shipping across the continental U.S.



You can expect freight quotes customized to your delivery location and project requirements. Each
order is assessed individually so you're not working from a one-size-fits-all rate sheet. Southern
Geo Supply operates from multiple locations including Shreveport, Vicksburg, Lake Charles, Monroe,
Texarkana, and Little Rock, with the ability to coordinate logistics across state and regional
lines.



This approach is built on more than two decades of combined industry knowledge in erosion control
and geosynthetic systems. You'll have access to technical support that extends beyond product
availability, helping you match materials to site conditions and performance goals. Southern Geo
Supply functions as both a supplier and a resource during planning and execution.

### How the Pre-Order Process Works

Southern Geo Supply operates on a pre-order basis to ensure that every delivery aligns with your
timeline and location. You won't be selecting from static inventory or guessing at lead times.
Instead, each request triggers a review of your specifications, site requirements, and shipping
destination. The result is a freight quote that reflects real project conditions rather than generic
estimates.



This model also allows for better coordination with manufacturers and carriers. You're not locked
into standard shipping windows or forced to adjust your project schedule to fit a supplier's stock
rotation. The system is designed to adapt to the variables that define construction and engineering
work.



The process includes several key elements that support predictable planning:


* Custom freight quoting for each order based on delivery location and project scope
* Partnerships with recognized manufacturers to maintain product quality across geosynthetics and
  [erosion control systems][52]
* Nationwide commercial shipping excluding Alaska and Puerto Rico, with coordination for multi-site
  deliveries
* Technical support from a team with over 20 years of combined experience in [geotextiles][53],
  geogrid, and geocell applications



[Request a quote][54] to receive tailored freight pricing and delivery coordination for your next
project.

### Working With a Supplier That Understands the Field

Southern Geo Supply has built its operations around the realities of erosion control and ground
stabilization work. With more than 20 years of combined industry experience, the team understands
how material selection, site conditions, and [delivery][55] logistics intersect. That depth of
knowledge informs every quote, every product recommendation, and every shipping arrangement.



You're working with a company that sources from recognized manufacturers and treats each order as a
distinct engineering challenge. Whether you're reinforcing soil, managing runoff, or stabilizing
slopes, the focus remains on matching the right materials to the job at hand. Southern Geo Supply is
positioned to support both procurement and technical decision-making throughout your project cycle.

continue to densify and consolidate over time. Once the solids are fully consolidated or have met

## Featured Tool: Titan Road Design Calculator

The Titan Road Design Calculator is a powerful online design tool built to simplify
geogrid-supported roadway design for engineers, contractors, and project owners. Using
industry-recognized methodologies—including Giroud-Han for unpaved roads and Modified AASHTO 1993
for paved and unpaved applications—the calculator delivers instant design calculations and
reinforcement recommendations based on your project-specific inputs. Generate detailed PDF design
summaries and optimize aggregate thickness with confidence. Whether you’re designing haul roads,
access roads, working platforms, or permanent pavements, the Calculator helps you make faster,
smarter, and more cost-effective design decisions.

[Try the Calculator][55]

For over two decades, Titan has grown from a small installation team into a trusted provider of
geosynthetic, environmental, and infrastructure solutions across North America. Built on a
foundation of problem-solving, technical expertise, and strong partnerships, we help customers
protect critical infrastructure, manage water and containment challenges, and stabilize land for
long-term performance. As we celebrate 20 years, we remain focused on delivering practical,
engineered solutions that perform in the field—today and into the future.

## Featured Tool: Titan Road Design Calculator

The Titan Road Design Calculator is a powerful online design tool built to simplify
geogrid-supported roadway design for engineers, contractors, and project owners. Using
industry-recognized methodologies—including Giroud-Han for unpaved roads and Modified AASHTO 1993
for paved and unpaved applications—the calculator delivers instant design calculations and
reinforcement recommendations based on your project-specific inputs. Generate detailed PDF design
summaries and optimize aggregate thickness with confidence. Whether you’re designing haul roads,
access roads, working platforms, or permanent pavements, the Calculator helps you make faster,
smarter, and more cost-effective design decisions.

### Welcome to tynod geosynthetics

Tynod Geosynthetics specialize in providing a complete range of geosynthetic solutions designed to

erosion control, road construction, embankment reinforcement, landfill lining, and water management
projects**.

We serve a global network of distributors, construction companies, and end-users across **South

solutions. Whether you are expanding infrastructure, reinforcing terrain, or managing environmental
challenges, Tynod stands as your reliable partner in building sustainable foundations for the
future.
